description: Relaxing Music | Surbahar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of deep, slow Indian classical surbahar to ease your evening down.
Ninety minutes of the surbahar's deep, resonant strings in Raga Khamaj — warm, unhurried, and spacious — for the hours when the day is done and you finally get to slow down.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume while you cook, read, stretch, or sit on the balcony. Music for doing less.
⏱ BEST FOR — evening wind-down · slow living · gentle relaxation · unplugging after work · quiet company
🎵 ABOUT — the surbahar is the bass sitar of Indian classical music, built for slowness; Raga Khamaj is the light, warm raga of easeful evenings.
